name: Gen 3 Type 65 Coupe-R Complete Kit
model: Coupe-R Complete Kit: competition cage chassis, KONI coil-overs (750 lb front / 500 lb rear), 3-link standard, aero body with scoops, mesh vents and rivet-on spoiler, high-back race seat, driver 5-point harness
users: GT_Rich (427 SBF Coupe R), Wake Productions, Snap-on build
notes: FFR's competition version: SCCA/NASA-legal cage chassis, track spring rates, a fixed high-back race seat and the Coupe-R aero body. $2,000 over the street kit. The IRS is still an option. A cage you drive next to without a helmet is a real hazard and needs padding; the springs are harsh on Washington roads; confirm A/C, side windows and seat tracks clear the cage before ordering. If it is the look you want, every aero piece is an option on the street kit.
popWhy: A few race-leaning builds; street coupes order the standard kit and add the aero

name: Aero vents, offset hood scoop & footbox vents
model: 60372 Aero Vents, 1 Off-Set Hood Scoop & 2 Small Footbox Vents
notes: The single option that most changes the car's look: the Coupe-R hood scoop plus the small vents in the footbox sides. Bonded and glassed in before paint, so decide before the body goes to the shop. Price is on the FFR quote, not the public form.
popWhy: Seen on Coupe-R builds and a handful of street coupes

name: Road race rear spoiler
model: 60627 Road Race Spoiler (mounts not included); 60537 Wing Mount Components
notes: The rivet-on rear spoiler from the Coupe-R. Adds the race profile and a lip to mount a camera. Rivets through the tail, so it is paint-shop work. Price on request.
popWhy: Coupe-R builds; rare on street cars

name: Coupe-R nose and rear side ducts
model: 60621 Coupe-R Nose Side Ducts; 60622 Coupe-R Rear Side Ducts
notes: The mesh-covered duct openings cut into the nose and ahead of the rear wheels. Cosmetic on a street car unless you plumb brake cooling; they are holes in the body, so rain and road spray get in behind them.

name: Coupe-R front aero bumper, canards & splitter
model: 60472 Coupe-R Front Aero Bumper; 60471 Coupe-R Front Canards; 60844 Carbon Fiber Front Splitter
notes: The track-day front end. Low splitters scrape on driveways and speed bumps; canards are the most Coupe-R-looking piece and the first to crack in a parking lot. Pick for looks knowingly.

name: Competition high-back aluminum race seats
model: 13852 Upgrade: Competition High-Back Aluminum Race Seats, black fabric
notes: The fixed high-back shell the Coupe-R ships with. Tall shoulder wings eat headroom under the coupe roof and make getting in harder; a fixed shell means no tracks, so the seat is bolted for one driver. For a shared street car the low-back seats keep the look and give the roof back.
popWhy: Coupe-R builds; street coupes pick the low-backs
